visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and gold hoop earrings holds a black Louis Vuitton lipstick and an eyeshadow compact against a neutral indoor background. She is wearing a dark blue lace-up garment. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a large orange Louis Vuitton shopping bag sitting on a grey textured surface with a white curtain in the background. (3) Hands with manicured nails pull a burgundy Louis Vuitton box out of the shopping bag. (4) A white envelope with handwritten script 'lovemiihuang' is shown resting on the textured surface. (5) Hands open the envelope to reveal a personalized note and a card with a QR code and the Louis Vuitton logo. (6) A close-up shows the burgundy box opening to reveal a pink interior holding a black lipstick tube and a circular eyeshadow compact. (7) The circular eyeshadow compact is shown in detail, featuring a black textured surface with a gold Louis Vuitton monogram. (8) A hand picks up the black lipstick tube, highlighting the gold band with the floral monogram. (9) The top of the lipstick cap is shown with the gold floral monogram. (10) The woman is back on screen, applying the deep red lipstick to her lips with a professional makeup brush. (11) She poses with the lipstick tube near her face, showcasing the finished lip look. (12) A close-up shows the gold-trimmed eyeshadow compact opening to reveal four distinct shades: burgundy, gold, brown, and dark plum. (13) The woman uses a small brush to apply the eyeshadow, looking into the mirror within the compact. (14) She continues the makeup application, brushing her eyelids and high cheekbones. (15) Final shot shows the woman smiling and posing with the open eyeshadow palette, showcasing her complete high-fashion makeup look.
